recognize_zh: 右側血片中的淋巴芽細胞核質比高、染色質細緻、細胞質少且呈嗜鹼性而無顆粒；左側流式直方圖顯示 CRLF2 PE 右移、陽性 76.72%，提示 CRLF2 過度表現，支持 Ph-like B-ALL 的篩檢方向。
features: Medium to large blasts with high N:C ratio and scant agranular basophilic cytoplasm
Round to irregular/indented nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
No Auer rods or cytoplasmic granules
Flow histogram: CRLF2 (PE) expression shifted above the negative control, 76.72% positive
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows numerous medium to large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, finely dispersed chromatin, irregular to indented nuclear contours and a thin rim of agranular basophilic cytoplasm. Accompanying flow cytometric histogram demonstrates overexpression of CRLF2 on the blast population (76.72% positive relative to the negative control gate). Blast morphology alone does not distinguish genetic subtypes; together with a B-lymphoblast immunophenotype, CRLF2 overexpression is suggestive of B-lymphoblastic leukemia, BCR::ABL1-like, which requires confirmation by FISH or molecular studies for CRLF2 rearrangement or other kinase-activating lesions.

ddx.vs: Morphology and immunophenotype are indistinguishable; the presence of t(9;22)/BCR::ABL1 by FISH or RT-PCR separates it from BCR::ABL1-like B-ALL.

ddx.dx: B-ALL, NOS or other genetic subtypes
ddx.vs: CRLF2 expression is typically negative, and subtype assignment relies on cytogenetics and molecular testing rather than blast morphology.

ddx.dx: Acute myeloid leukemia with minimal differentiation
ddx.vs: Blasts can look similar but express myeloid markers (CD13/CD33/CD117) and lack B-lineage markers such as CD19, CD79a and PAX5.
Cells are mature B cells with surface light chain restriction, CD5 and cyclin D1, and lack TdT and CD34.
